title: Multihomogeneous Measures and Stochastic Polar Representations
summary: Let \(q\in\mathbb N\), let \(G=(0,\infty)^q\), and let $ S:G\times E\longrightarrow E, (r,x)\longmapsto S_rx $ be a jointly measurable left action on an arbitrary measurable space \((E,\mathcal E)\).
